2026-10-08 · LocoManip-Marl-Direct-v0, marl-direct · Isaac Sim 5.1 and MuJoCo 3.15

Reach below standing height with reward-coupled leg and arm policies on the Unitree H1-2

The λ = 0.5 policy brings both wrists within 10 cm and 0.6 rad of their targets for 1 s in 11% of the goals whose lower wrist target lies below the standing table (0.89 m) and in 49% of those above it. GOLEM's arm IK on a standing robot does so for 0% and 52%; the lowest 0.1 m band in which half of the unextended goals succeed is 0.8 m for the policy and 1.0 m for the IK. With its legs blind to the goal the same networks reach 1% and 18%. Under the strict test (5 cm and 0.35 rad) the policy reaches 2% and 8%. For the low goals the pelvis drops a median 19 cm (2 cm with blind legs). In MuJoCo with RoboCasa's joint dynamics it reaches 11% of all goals within 10 cm, against 27% in Isaac.

Figures

Every figure is in paper/reach/figures/ as PDF (fonts embedded) and PNG, with its plotted numbers in figures/data/.

Adding a run

Set the run directory (run:) of each λ in paper/reach/conditions.yaml, and of whole for the one-agent whole-body baseline (LocoManip-WholeBody-Direct-v0, recognised from its checkpoint), then from the Locomanipulation_game checkout:

conda activate env_isaaclab51        # Isaac Sim 5.1, Isaac Lab main 2.3.2, skrl 2.1
make -C paper/reach all              # evaluates every listed run without current results, then figures, numbers, page
                                     # (DEVICE=cpu when another job holds the GPU)

Each Isaac variant takes about 5 minutes on the GPU or 20 on 12 CPU cores, each MuJoCo variant 3 minutes on 8 cores. The paper text quotes numbers as \reach{l1/isaac}{success_below} from paper/reach/tex/results_macros.tex; a number not computed yet prints ??.

Terms and metrics
, reward share
The share of the other agent's task reward each agent receives (REWARD_SHARE), one scalar in both directions, read from each run's params/env.yaml:
(1)
Goal
A pair of wrist poses placed in the standing frame (the pelvis's x, y and yaw when the goal starts, origin 1.0024 m above the ground) and fixed in the world for 4 s.
Goal lowering , extension (m)
Base goals come from the task's standing-reachable table; each is lowered by and pushed outward from each shoulder in the ground plane. The table's lowest pose is 0.89 m above the ground.
Strict success
Both wrists inside 5 cm and 0.35 rad of their true world targets for 1 s without a break (the task's reach test):
(2)
1 s hold error (cm)
Over every 1 s window of the goal, the worst position error of either wrist; the best window's value. A trial succeeds at position tolerance τ alone when this is below τ.
Pelvis drop (cm)
Pelvis height when the goal starts minus its mean over the goal's last second.
CoM / DCM margin (cm)
Signed distance from the centre of mass's ground projection (or ) to the edge of the support polygon of the feet carrying more than 20 N, positive inside:
(3)
Fall
Base tilt beyond 1 rad, the task's termination.
Foot slip, steps, wrist jitter
Horizontal speed of a foot carrying more than 50 N; foot lift-offs during the goal; RMS distance of a wrist from its mean position over the last second.
Evaluation design

3,168 goals: 96 base pose pairs × lowerings 0 to 1.0 m in 0.1 m steps × extensions 0.0, 0.1, 0.2 m. A trial resets the robot with the training distribution, stands for 2 s under a zero velocity command, then holds one goal for 4 s. Actors act through their mean actions with observation noise on; the learned pelvis estimator moves the goal they observe; the depth curriculum is frozen; Isaac's training randomization is pinned at its midpoint and pushes are off. Variants of one checkpoint: legs blind (the legs observe navigation inputs, without the goal), arms IK only (the arms' residual held at zero), true odometry. GOLEM's arm IK (h12_ros2_controller, IKSolver.solve_ik_reduced) solves each goal on a standing robot with its deployed settings. The arm action of the policies is

(4)

From the same state, the MuJoCo port reproduces every observation term to 1.1e-05 and the joint targets to 1.9e-05 rad (tools/parity_check.py). The arms' IK step matches only with the wrist Jacobian at the link's centre of mass, where PhysX computes it.

Review of the experiment brief
  • Success test, curriculum thresholds and the single symmetric λ match the code.
  • The brief's depth grid (0 to 0.4 m) is out of date: the code lowers goals up to 1.0 m (zmax = 0.1 kd), and the run at 52.8k steps had 77% of its environments at the deepest level. The grid spans 0 to 1.0 m and results are reported against absolute target height.
  • The blind-legs variant measures the reach the legs add from one checkpoint; λ = 0 is still needed to tie the crouch to reward sharing.
  • Learning efficiency can be read from saved files: each estimator_<N>.pt stores every environment's curriculum level.
  • A model-based whole-body baseline would be a stronger fourth line than a monolithic policy.
Open items
  • λ = 1, λ = 0, Whole-body agent: set run: in conditions.yaml and run make -C paper/reach all. Comparing their pelvis drop and 10 cm success below the table with the hero's tells whether the crouch depends on the reward share.
  • Position limits the strict test: 5% of the hero's trials hold both wrists within 5 cm for 1 s and 47% within 0.35 rad (GOLEM IK: 13% and 99%). eval_isaac.py --variant arms_ik --ext0 and --odometry true --ext0 separate the learned residual and the pelvis estimator's drift.
  • High goals: the hero's 10 cm success falls from 55% at 1.4–1.5 m to 24% at 1.6–1.7 m, with the pelvis 19 cm below standing height. Next: the training curriculum's goal heights at depth level 10 against the grid's (commands.py lowers goals by up to 1.0 m).
  • MuJoCo transfer: within 10 cm the hero reaches 11% with RoboCasa's joints against 27% in Isaac. The policy loop matches Isaac to 2e-5 from the same state, so the gap lies in the plant; next: tools/parity_check.py extended from one step to a second of stance from the same state, to find the first quantity that diverges.
  • Learning curves on the fixed grid: make -C paper/reach curve RUN=<run> LABEL=<label> (every saved checkpoint, unextended goals).

Rebuild: make -C paper/reach paper. Trials: paper/reach/results/<label>/<sim>/trials.csv; goals paper/reach/goals/eval_goals_v1.csv.
